blocks.zh: PFS開發與註冊：系統功能、法規考量與申請策略
blocks.en: PFS Development and Licensing: System Functions, Regulatory Considerations and Filing Strategy

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握預充填注射器 (PFS) 在美國與歐盟的法規定位，理解「組合產品 (combination product)」的監管架構與 PMOA 原則
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory positioning of prefilled syringes (PFS) in the US and EU, including the combination product framework and the PMOA principle

blocks.zh: 理解 PFS 三大關鍵系統功能：治療病患、取得市場許可、生產與配送藥物遞送系統
blocks.en: Understand the three key PFS system functions: treating the patient, obtaining approval, and producing and delivering the drug delivery system

blocks.zh: 瞭解藥廠與供應商在 DMF 申請中各自的角色與責任，包括 Type III 及 Type V DMF 的適用情境
blocks.en: Understand the respective roles and responsibilities of drug manufacturers and suppliers in DMF filings, including when Type III and Type V DMFs apply

blocks.zh: 掌握 CTD Module 3 中 PFS 組合產品所需的申請內容要素，包括設計管控、相容性、穩定性及 CCI 要求
blocks.en: Understand the filing content required for a PFS combination product in CTD Module 3, including design controls, compatibility, stability and CCI requirements

blocks.zh: 認識適用於 PFS 開發的主要標準與技術參考文獻體系
blocks.en: Become familiar with the main standards and technical references that apply to PFS development

blocks.zh: 3.0 PFS Development and Licensing PFS開發與註冊
blocks.en: 3.0 PFS Development and Licensing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Combination Product（組合產品）：PFS 在美國被定性為「組合產品」，因為它同時具有藥品（drug）和醫療器材（device）的特性。監管主導機構取決於 PMOA（主要作用模式）：
blocks.en: Combination Product: In the US, a PFS is classified as a combination product because it has the characteristics of both a drug and a device. The lead regulatory center depends on the PMOA (primary mode of action):

blocks.zh: CDER：主導小分子藥物 PFS
blocks.en: CDER: leads for PFS containing small-molecule drugs

blocks.zh: CBER：主導生物製品 PFS（如單株抗體、疫苗）
blocks.en: CBER: leads for PFS containing biological products (e.g., monoclonal antibodies, vaccines)

blocks.zh: CDRH：當器材功能為主時
blocks.en: CDRH: leads when the device function predominates

blocks.zh: 歐盟情況：EU 目前沒有「combination product」的明確定義，PFS 依主要功能歸類為藥品或醫材，受 Directive 2001/83/EC 或 MDD 93/42/EEC 管轄。
blocks.en: European Union: The EU currently has no clear definition of a "combination product". A PFS is classified as either a medicinal product or a medical device according to its principal function, and is governed by Directive 2001/83/EC or MDD 93/42/EEC respectively.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你開發了一種「預裝咖啡的保溫杯」。監管機關會問：這個產品的主要功能是「咖啡（藥品）」還是「保溫杯（器材）」？如果主要目的是讓咖啡安全到達消費者手中（藥品功能主導），就由食品局管；如果主要賣點是保溫功能，就由消費品安全委員會管。PFS 的 PMOA 判斷就是這個邏輯 — 誰主導，誰審。對 CDMO 而言，這個判斷在接受委託開發前就必須釐清，直接影響法規策略與申請時程。
blocks.en: Imagine you have developed a "pre-filled coffee thermos". The regulator will ask: is the primary function of this product the coffee (the drug) or the thermos (the device)? If the main purpose is to get the coffee safely to the consumer (drug function predominates), the food authority takes charge; if the main selling point is heat retention, the consumer product safety commission takes charge. The PMOA determination for a PFS follows the same logic: whichever function predominates determines who reviews. For a CDMO, this determination must be clarified before accepting a development contract, because it directly affects the regulatory strategy and filing timeline.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務影響：作為受託製造方，必須在合約中明確規定由 License Holder（藥廠）負責確認 PMOA 及主管機關，CDMO 不應自行假設。不同主管機關的 cGMP 要求（21 CFR 820 vs 21 CFR 211）對廠房認證、文件體系影響巨大。
blocks.en: Practical impact for a CDMO: As the contract manufacturer, the CDMO must specify in the contract that the license holder (the drug company) is responsible for confirming the PMOA and the lead regulatory authority; the CDMO should not make this assumption on its own. The cGMP requirements of different authorities (21 CFR 820 vs 21 CFR 211) have a major impact on facility certification and the documentation system.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一支含有胰島素的預充填注射器，其 PMOA 如何判定？會由 CDER 還是 CBER 主管？
blocks.en: How is the PMOA determined for a prefilled syringe containing insulin? Will CDER or CBER take the lead?

blocks.zh: 為什麼歐盟沒有「combination product」的正式定義對 PFS 開發者而言是一個挑戰？
blocks.en: Why is the lack of a formal EU definition of "combination product" a challenge for PFS developers?

blocks.zh: 3.1 High-Level Overview of Key System Functions PFS關鍵系統功能總覽
blocks.en: 3.1 High-Level Overview of Key System Functions

blocks.zh: PFS 三大關鍵系統功能：
blocks.en: The three key PFS system functions:

blocks.zh: 治療病患：確保藥品在正確時間、正確劑量、正確途徑到達目標組織
blocks.en: Treating the patient: ensure the drug reaches the target tissue at the right time, in the right dose, by the right route

blocks.zh: 取得市場許可：提供完整的資料包，證明 PFS 適用於預期用途
blocks.en: Obtaining approval: provide a complete data package demonstrating that the PFS is suitable for its intended use

blocks.zh: 生產與配送：確保系統與充填、組裝、配送流程相容
blocks.en: Production and delivery: ensure the system is compatible with the filling, assembly and distribution processes

blocks.zh: 這三個功能並非獨立存在，而是相互制約。例如：為了治療病患所選擇的高黏度製劑，可能對充填製程（生產功能）和注射力道（人體因素）產生重大影響。
blocks.en: These three functions do not exist independently; they constrain one another. For example, a high-viscosity formulation chosen to treat the patient may significantly affect the filling process (production function) and the injection force (human factors).

blocks.zh: 影響注射的關鍵變數：藥液黏度 (viscosity) 直接影響注射時間和所需推桿力。對蛋白質藥物（如單株抗體）而言，高濃度製劑的黏度往往是開發挑戰，這在 3.1.1 提到的「duration of injection」和「injection technique」因素中有所體現。
blocks.en: Key variables affecting injection: Drug viscosity directly affects injection time and the plunger force required. For protein drugs such as monoclonal antibodies, the viscosity of high-concentration formulations is often a development challenge, which is reflected in the "duration of injection" and "injection technique" factors mentioned in 3.1.1.

blocks.zh: License Holder 的資料責任：3.1.2 強調 license holder 必須生成「comprehensive data package」。對 CDMO 而言，需在服務協議中明確哪些數據由 CDMO 生成、哪些由 License Holder 負責整合提交。
blocks.en: Data responsibilities of the license holder: Section 3.1.2 stresses that the license holder must generate a "comprehensive data package". For a CDMO, the service agreement should state clearly which data the CDMO generates and which the license holder is responsible for compiling and submitting.

blocks.zh: 如果一個單株抗體 PFS 產品的黏度非常高（>50 cP），這會如何同時影響三個關鍵系統功能？
blocks.en: If a monoclonal antibody PFS product has a very high viscosity (>50 cP), how would this affect all three key system functions at the same time?

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要同時考慮「自我注射」和「醫護人員注射」兩種情境？這對 PFS 設計有何影響？
blocks.en: Why must both "self-injection" and "injection by a healthcare professional" be considered? How does this affect PFS design?

blocks.zh: 3.1.3 Key System Function: Enabling Production and Distribution of the Delivery System 生產與配送系統功能
blocks.en: 3.1.3 Key System Function: Enabling Production and Distribution of the Delivery System

blocks.zh: Ventube™ / Vacuum 灌塞法：活塞插入（plunging）有兩種主要方法。Vacuum plunging 在低壓環境下插入活塞，可有效避免注射器內殘留空氣，對某些敏感藥品（如蛋白質製劑）至關重要。選擇何種方法直接影響設備投資和製程驗證策略。
blocks.en: Ventube™ / vacuum plunging: There are two main methods of plunger insertion (plunging). Vacuum plunging inserts the plunger under reduced pressure, which effectively avoids residual air in the syringe and is essential for certain sensitive drugs (e.g., protein formulations). The choice of method directly affects equipment investment and the process validation strategy.

blocks.zh: 三層包裝的冷鏈保護：
blocks.en: Cold chain protection through three levels of packaging:

blocks.zh: 一次包裝 (primary)：玻璃管身 + 活塞 + 針頭護套
blocks.en: Primary packaging: glass barrel + plunger stopper + needle shield

blocks.zh: 二次包裝 (secondary)：泡殼或托盤，提供機械保護
blocks.en: Secondary packaging: blister or tray, providing mechanical protection

blocks.zh: 三次包裝 (tertiary)：外箱，用於配送運輸
blocks.en: Tertiary packaging: outer carton, used for distribution and transport

blocks.zh: PFS 的生產相容性就像「食品工廠的包裝線設計」。如果你開發了一種特殊形狀的果凍，但現有的充填機無法處理這種形狀，你就面臨兩個選擇：重新設計果凍（修改產品設計）或購買新設備（增加資本投入）。對 CDMO 而言，在評估新客戶產品時，首先要確認現有充填線與目標 PFS 規格的相容性 — 這是接單可行性評估的第一步。
blocks.en: PFS manufacturing compatibility is like the "packaging line design of a food factory". If you develop a jelly with a special shape that the existing filling machine cannot handle, you face two choices: redesign the jelly (change the product design) or buy new equipment (increase capital investment). For a CDMO assessing a new client product, the first step in the feasibility assessment is to confirm that the existing filling line is compatible with the target PFS specification.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Section 3.0 在 TR73 中的位置圖（fig-p14-1）顯示本節（3.0 PFS Development & Licensing）是整份技術報告的「起點」，周圍是 4.0 Human Factors、5.0 E&L、6.0-8.0 Glass/Needle、9.0 Cosmetic、10.0 Siliconization、11.0 Plunger Stopper、12.0 CCI、13.0 Manufacturing、14.0 Drug Compatibility 等各主題節。這個結構圖傳達了一個重要訊息：開發決策（Section 3）會牽動後續所有技術節的考量，必須從整體生命週期視角規劃。
blocks.en: The location diagram for Section 3.0 in TR73 (fig-p14-1) shows that this section (3.0 PFS Development & Licensing) is the "starting point" of the whole technical report, surrounded by the topic sections 4.0 Human Factors, 5.0 E&L, 6.0-8.0 Glass/Needle, 9.0 Cosmetic, 10.0 Siliconization, 11.0 Plunger Stopper, 12.0 CCI, 13.0 Manufacturing and 14.0 Drug Compatibility. This structure conveys an important message: development decisions (Section 3) affect the considerations in every subsequent technical section, so planning must take a whole-lifecycle view.

blocks.zh: 若一個客戶要求使用 Vacuum plunging 工藝，但 CDMO 現有設備只支援 Ventube™，應如何在合約談判階段評估這個需求？
blocks.en: If a client requires a vacuum plunging process but the CDMO's existing equipment supports only Ventube™, how should this requirement be assessed at the contract negotiation stage?

blocks.zh: 冷鏈產品（如需 2-8°C 儲存的生物製品）的二次和三次包裝設計需要考慮哪些額外的驗證要求？
blocks.en: What additional validation requirements must be considered for the secondary and tertiary packaging of cold chain products (e.g., biologics requiring 2-8°C storage)?

blocks.en: Reading the table: The table uses "•" to mark the party responsible for each function. Note that "Fill/Finish Manufacturing Equipment" (i.e., the CDMO's role) is involved in every item under all three key system functions, which highlights the CDMO's central position across the whole PFS lifecycle. "Distribution" and "Patient" are involved to a much lesser extent, mainly in the requirement to adequately protect the dosage form.

blocks.zh:
Notes on Contributors and Stakeholders（貢獻者與利害關係人說明）：
  1. "Drug" refers to the medicine delivered in the PFS.
  2. The PFS subsystem includes a packaged glass barrel with an attached needle that is protected with a needle shield and a plunger stopper.
  3. "Manufacturing equipment" refers to the different machines used to process the subsystem to produce a full drug delivery system. Tasks include filling, stoppering, inspecting, or preparing secondary packaging.
  4. Ancillary devices include autoinjectors, safety devices, plunger rods, backstops, and other assistive devices.
  5. "Distribution" refers to the outbound distribution channel from the license holder to the patient.
  6. The patient is the person who ultimately receives the treatment.
blocks.en:
Notes on Contributors and Stakeholders:
  1. "Drug" refers to the medicine delivered in the PFS.
  2. The PFS subsystem includes a packaged glass barrel with an attached needle that is protected with a needle shield and a plunger stopper.
  3. "Manufacturing equipment" refers to the different machines used to process the subsystem to produce a full drug delivery system. Tasks include filling, stoppering, inspecting, or preparing secondary packaging.
  4. Ancillary devices include autoinjectors, safety devices, plunger rods, backstops, and other assistive devices.
  5. "Distribution" refers to the outbound distribution channel from the license holder to the patient.
  6. The patient is the person who ultimately receives the treatment.

blocks.zh: 3.2 Regulatory Considerations 法規考量
blocks.en: 3.2 Regulatory Considerations

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 4 的「一主一輔」合規原則：對 PFS 組合產品，21 CFR 4 提供兩種合規路徑：
blocks.en: The "one primary, one supplementary" compliance principle of 21 CFR 4: For a PFS combination product, 21 CFR 4 provides two compliance pathways:

blocks.zh: 全合規路徑：同時滿足 21 CFR 211（藥品）和 21 CFR 820（器材）的所有要求
blocks.en: Full compliance pathway: meet all requirements of both 21 CFR 211 (drugs) and 21 CFR 820 (devices)

blocks.zh: 精簡路徑：選擇其中一套為主要依循，再補充另一套中不重疊的要求
blocks.en: Streamlined pathway: choose one set as the primary basis, then add the non-overlapping requirements of the other

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 820 特別要求的「額外規定」包括：management responsibility（管理層責任）、design controls（設計管控）、purchasing controls（採購管控）、CAPA（矯正與預防措施）。
blocks.en: The "additional provisions" specifically required by 21 CFR 820 include management responsibility, design controls, purchasing controls and CAPA (corrective and preventive action).

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 4 的合規策略就像「跨國工作簽證」。若你同時在台灣和日本工作，有兩種方式：一是取得兩個國家的完整工作許可（全合規路徑，成本最高但最保險）；二是以一個國家的許可為主，再補辦另一國要求的特定附加文件（精簡路徑，適合主要在一個司法管轄區運作的廠商）。CDMO 在接受組合產品委託前，必須與 License Holder 確認採用哪種合規策略，因為這直接影響品質系統建置的成本與時程。
blocks.en: The 21 CFR 4 compliance strategy is like a "multinational work visa". If you work in both Taiwan and Japan, there are two ways: obtain full work permits for both countries (the full compliance pathway: highest cost but safest), or rely mainly on the permit of one country and apply for the specific additional documents the other requires (the streamlined pathway: suited to companies operating mainly in one jurisdiction). Before accepting a combination product contract, the CDMO must confirm with the license holder which compliance strategy will be used, because it directly affects the cost and timeline of building the quality system.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 vs 21 CFR 820：ISO 13485 是歐盟 MDD 認可的品質管理系統標準，在全球多個市場廣泛接受。21 CFR 820 是美國 FDA 的器材品質系統法規。兩者高度相似但有差異。CDMO 若已取得 ISO 13485 認證，在進入 EU 市場時具有明顯優勢。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 vs 21 CFR 820: ISO 13485 is the quality management system standard recognized under the EU MDD and is widely accepted in many markets worldwide. 21 CFR 820 is the US FDA quality system regulation for devices. The two are highly similar but not identical. A CDMO that already holds ISO 13485 certification has a clear advantage when entering the EU market.

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 風險管理：此標準要求廠商對器材的整個生命週期進行系統性風險管理，需產生完整的風險管理檔案 (Risk Management File)，與 ICH Q9 的 QRM 原則高度互補。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 risk management: This standard requires manufacturers to manage risk systematically across the whole device lifecycle and to produce a complete Risk Management File. It is highly complementary to the QRM principles of ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 一家台灣 CDMO 要接受美國客戶的單株抗體 PFS 委託製造，需要同時符合 21 CFR 211 和 21 CFR 820 的哪些特定要求？
blocks.en: For a Taiwanese CDMO to accept a contract to manufacture a monoclonal antibody PFS for a US client, which specific requirements of 21 CFR 211 and 21 CFR 820 must be met at the same time?

blocks.zh: 歐盟 Directive 2001/83/EC 與 MDD 93/42/EEC 對 PFS 的適用範圍如何區分？
blocks.en: How do the scopes of application of EU Directive 2001/83/EC and MDD 93/42/EEC differ for a PFS?

blocks.zh: 3.2.2 Supplier Considerations for Filing 供應商申請考量
blocks.en: 3.2.2 Supplier Considerations for Filing

blocks.zh: DMF 類型對照：
blocks.en: Comparison of DMF types:

blocks.zh: Type III DMF：包裝材料（如彈性體封口元件）—— 涵蓋橡膠配方、BSE/TSE 認證、理化特性及生物反應性測試
blocks.en: Type III DMF: packaging materials (e.g., elastomeric closure components) - covers rubber formulation, BSE/TSE certification, physicochemical properties and biological reactivity testing

blocks.zh: Type V DMF：FDA 接受的特定製造設施、製程或文章 —— 供應商對彈性體元件進行後處理（如清洗、滅菌）時，相關製程驗證資料可放入此類型
blocks.en: Type V DMF: FDA-accepted reference information (specific facilities, processes or articles) - when a supplier performs post-processing of elastomeric components (e.g., washing, sterilization), the related process validation data can be placed in this type

blocks.zh: 授權信函 (Letter of Authorization)：DMF 擁有者（供應商）授權藥廠（sponsor）在其申請案中引用該 DMF 的機制。一旦 DMF 有重大變更，供應商必須主動通知所有授權信持有人。
blocks.en: Letter of Authorization: the mechanism by which the DMF holder (the supplier) authorizes a drug company (the sponsor) to reference the DMF in its application. When there is a major change to the DMF, the supplier must proactively notify all holders of letters of authorization.

blocks.zh: DMF 制度就像「建材供應商提交給建管局的技術規格檔案」。你要蓋一棟建築，不需要親自測試每一根鋼筋的品質 —— 你引用鋼筋廠商已預先提交給建管局的材料認證檔案（DMF），並取得廠商的「授權使用書」（Letter of Authorization）即可。若鋼筋廠商後來更換了鋼材配方（DMF 重大變更），他們必須通知所有使用其授權書的建築業者 —— 這就是 21 CFR 314.420(c) 的精神。對 CDMO 而言，在供應商合約中明確要求「DMF 重大變更需提前 X 天通知」是風險管控的基本要求。
blocks.en: The DMF system is like a "technical specification file that a building materials supplier submits to the building authority". To construct a building, you do not need to test every steel bar yourself; you reference the material certification file the steel manufacturer has already submitted to the authority (the DMF) and obtain the manufacturer's "letter of authorization". If the steel manufacturer later changes the steel formulation (a major DMF change), it must notify every builder holding its letter of authorization, which is the spirit of 21 CFR 314.420(c). For a CDMO, requiring in the supplier contract that "major DMF changes be notified X days in advance" is a basic risk control requirement.

blocks.zh: BSE/TSE 認證的重要性：牛海綿狀腦病 (BSE) / 傳播性海綿狀腦病 (TSE) 認證是生物來源原料的必要文件。彈性體元件（如橡膠活塞）的配方中若含有動物來源成分，必須提供相關認證，這是 EU 和 FDA 的共同要求。
blocks.en: The importance of BSE/TSE certification: Bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE) / transmissible spongiform encephalopathy (TSE) certification is a required document for raw materials of biological origin. If the formulation of an elastomeric component (e.g., a rubber plunger) contains animal-derived ingredients, the relevant certification must be provided; this is a common requirement of the EU and FDA.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在供應鏈管理中的角色：當 CDMO 採購 RTU（即用型）的已清洗/已滅菌元件時，需確認供應商是否已在其 DMF 中涵蓋後處理製程的驗證資料。若供應商使用 Type V DMF 涵蓋這些製程，CDMO 需取得相應授權。
blocks.en: The CDMO's role in supply chain management: When a CDMO purchases RTU (ready-to-use) washed/sterilized components, it must confirm whether the supplier's DMF covers validation data for the post-processing steps. If the supplier uses a Type V DMF to cover these processes, the CDMO must obtain the corresponding authorization.

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 採用 RTU 的預清洗活塞，供應商提交了 Type V DMF，CDMO 在申請材料中需要如何引用這個 DMF？
blocks.en: If a CDMO uses RTU pre-washed plungers and the supplier has submitted a Type V DMF, how should the CDMO reference this DMF in the filing materials?

blocks.zh: 供應商的 DMF 發生「重大變更」，CDMO 應在多快時間內評估其對現有客戶產品的影響？應建立什麼樣的 SOP？
blocks.en: If a supplier's DMF undergoes a "major change", how quickly should the CDMO assess the impact on existing client products? What SOP should be established?

blocks.zh: 3.2.3 Healthcare Provider Instruction for Use of PFSs 醫療人員使用說明
blocks.en: 3.2.3 Healthcare Provider Instruction for Use of PFSs

blocks.zh: 使用說明書 (Instructions for Use, IFU) 的法規要求：License Holder 有義務提供完整的 IFU，內容必須涵蓋：正確使用步驟、棄置要求（針頭廢棄物管理）、儲存條件。各國棄置法規不同，IFU 必須針對目標市場個別化。
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements for Instructions for Use (IFU): The license holder is obliged to provide a complete IFU, which must cover correct usage steps, disposal requirements (management of needle waste) and storage conditions. Disposal regulations differ by country, so the IFU must be tailored to each target market.

blocks.zh: 針刺傷害預防：OSHA 和 CDC 均有相關指引。主動安全注射器（active safety syringes）和被動安全系統的設計目的之一即為降低針刺傷害風險，這與 Section 4.0 Human Factors 高度相關。
blocks.en: Needlestick injury prevention: Both OSHA and the CDC have relevant guidance. One purpose of active safety syringes and passive safety systems is to reduce the risk of needlestick injury, which is closely related to Section 4.0 Human Factors.

blocks.zh: 台灣廠商的注意事項：台灣的醫療廢棄物處置受衛生福利部規範，與美國 OSHA 要求不同。若 CDMO 協助客戶開發台灣市場的 IFU，需確認符合台灣本地法規要求，而非直接套用美國版本。
blocks.en: Points for Taiwanese companies: Medical waste disposal in Taiwan is regulated by the Ministry of Health and Welfare and differs from US OSHA requirements. If a CDMO helps a client develop an IFU for the Taiwan market, it must confirm compliance with local Taiwanese regulations rather than simply applying the US version.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的責任範圍：IFU 的撰寫通常由 License Holder 負責。CDMO 應確認合約中清楚界定 IFU 責任歸屬，避免因此承擔未預期的法規責任。
blocks.en: Scope of the CDMO's responsibility: The IFU is normally written by the license holder. The CDMO should make sure the contract clearly defines who is responsible for the IFU, to avoid taking on unexpected regulatory liability.

blocks.zh: 若同一 PFS 產品需要在美國、歐盟和台灣三個市場上市，IFU 需要有幾個版本？各版本的主要差異可能在哪裡？
blocks.en: If the same PFS product is to be marketed in the US, EU and Taiwan, how many versions of the IFU are needed? What are the main differences between the versions likely to be?

blocks.zh: 3.2.4 Regulatory Submission Content for PFS Combination Products PFS組合產品的法規申請內容
blocks.en: 3.2.4 Regulatory Submission Content for PFS Combination Products

blocks.zh: NDA vs BLA 的選擇：
blocks.en: Choosing between NDA and BLA:

blocks.zh: NDA（新藥申請）：適用於化學合成藥物 PFS，主導機關通常為 CDER
blocks.en: NDA (New Drug Application): applies to PFS containing chemically synthesized drugs; the lead center is usually CDER

blocks.zh: BLA（生物製品許可申請）：適用於生物製品 PFS（抗體、疫苗等），主導機關為 CBER 或 CDER（視產品類型）
blocks.en: BLA (Biologics License Application): applies to PFS containing biological products (antibodies, vaccines, etc.); the lead center is CBER or CDER (depending on product type)

blocks.zh: Tungsten（鎢）污染的重要性：在製造注射針頭時，鎢針芯（tungsten pin）用於形成玻璃管的出口孔，之後移除。殘留的鎢氧化物可能與蛋白質藥物（如抗體）反應，誘發蛋白質聚集（aggregation）—— 這是一個直接影響產品安全性的關鍵品質問題。
blocks.en: The significance of tungsten contamination: In needle manufacturing, a tungsten pin is used to form the exit hole of the glass barrel and is removed afterwards. Residual tungsten oxide can react with protein drugs (e.g., antibodies) and induce protein aggregation, a critical quality issue that directly affects product safety.

blocks.zh: SAL 10⁻⁶ 的法規要求：無菌保證水準 (Sterility Assurance Level) 10⁻⁶ 意謂每百萬件產品中非無菌品的機率不超過 1 件。這是 PFS 滅菌驗證的基本法規門檻。
blocks.en: The SAL 10⁻⁶ regulatory requirement: A Sterility Assurance Level (SAL) of 10⁻⁶ means that the probability of a non-sterile unit is no more than 1 in 1 million units. This is the basic regulatory threshold for PFS sterilization validation.

blocks.zh: CTD Module 3 對 PFS 的申請內容，就像「房屋交屋時的完整文件包」。你蓋了一棟房子（製造了 PFS），要取得使用執照（市場許可），必須提交：建材規格（包裝元件說明）、施工圖（製程圖）、防火驗收（滅菌驗證）、防水測試（CCI 評估）、環境安全評估（E&L 研究）、結構安全報告（穩定性數據）。每一份文件對應到 CTD Module 3 的一個章節。對 CDMO 而言，熟悉這個「文件地圖」能幫助在接受委託時精準評估需要產生哪些數據，並在合約中明確分工。
blocks.en: The CTD Module 3 content for a PFS is like the "complete document package at house handover". You have built a house (manufactured the PFS) and, to obtain the occupancy permit (marketing authorization), you must submit: building material specifications (description of packaging components), construction drawings (process diagrams), fire safety acceptance (sterilization validation), waterproofing tests (CCI assessment), environmental safety assessment (E&L studies) and structural safety report (stability data). Each document corresponds to a section of CTD Module 3. For a CDMO, being familiar with this "document map" helps to assess precisely which data must be generated when accepting a contract, and to divide the work clearly in the contract.

blocks.zh: Break-loose 和 Glide Force 測試：
blocks.en: Break-loose and glide force testing:

blocks.zh: Break-loose force（啟動力）：初次推動活塞所需的力，通常高於持續推動力
blocks.en: Break-loose force: the force required to start moving the plunger initially; usually higher than the sustained force

blocks.zh: Glide force（滑動力）：活塞在持續移動過程中的阻力
blocks.en: Glide force: the resistance to the plunger during continuous movement

blocks.zh: 這兩個參數直接影響使用者體驗和劑量準確性，是 PFS 放行測試的必要項目，也受矽化（siliconization）程度影響。
blocks.en: These two parameters directly affect user experience and dose accuracy, are required items in PFS release testing, and are also affected by the degree of siliconization.

blocks.zh: 矽化（Siliconization）的雙面性：矽油提供潤滑（降低 glide force），但同時可能導致矽油顆粒污染藥液，對蛋白質藥物引發免疫反應。矽化量的控制需要精確優化，詳見 TR73 Section 10.0。
blocks.en: The two sides of siliconization: Silicone oil provides lubrication (lowering glide force), but may also cause silicone oil particles to contaminate the drug solution and trigger immune responses with protein drugs. The amount of silicone must be precisely optimized; see TR73 Section 10.0 for details.

blocks.zh: 一個凍乾 (lyophilized) 藥物的 PFS 版本在穩定性測試中需要特別監測哪些指標？水分控制的關鍵點在哪裡？
blocks.en: For a lyophilized drug in a PFS, which indicators need particular monitoring in stability testing? What are the key points of moisture control?

blocks.zh: 若在 E&L 研究中發現鎢含量偏高，有哪些可能的解決方案？（考慮設計、製程和規格三個層面）
blocks.en: If a high tungsten level is found in an E&L study, what solutions are possible? (Consider the design, process and specification levels.)

blocks.zh: Break-loose force 規格的設定應考慮哪些使用情境？（自我注射 vs 自動注射器）
blocks.en: What use scenarios should be considered when setting the break-loose force specification? (Self-injection vs autoinjector)

blocks.zh: 3.2.5 Standards and Technical References Applicable to PFS 適用於PFS的標準與技術參考
blocks.en: 3.2.5 Standards and Technical References Applicable to PFS

blocks.zh: PFS C/C System 適用性四要素：FDA 定義的四個評估面向：
blocks.en: The four elements of C/C system suitability for a PFS: The four evaluation aspects defined by the FDA:

blocks.zh: Protection（保護性）：能否保護藥品免受外部污染（微生物、環境）
blocks.en: Protection: whether the system protects the drug from external contamination (microbial, environmental)

blocks.zh: Safety（安全性）：包裝材料本身不會對病患造成傷害（E&L 安全評估）
blocks.en: Safety: the packaging materials themselves do not harm the patient (E&L safety assessment)

blocks.zh: Compatibility（相容性）：包裝材料與藥品之間不發生不良相互作用（不吸附、不催化降解）
blocks.en: Compatibility: no adverse interaction between the packaging materials and the drug (no adsorption, no catalysis of degradation)

blocks.zh: Performance（性能）：能正常執行預期功能（功能性測試，如注射力、CCI）
blocks.en: Performance: the system performs its intended function properly (functional testing, e.g., injection force, CCI)

blocks.zh: Target Product Profile (TPP)：目標產品概況是開發早期定義「理想產品應該是什麼樣子」的文件，驅動後續所有開發決策，包括 C/C system 的選擇與驗證策略。
blocks.en: Target Product Profile (TPP): The target product profile is a document that defines early in development what the ideal product should look like. It drives all subsequent development decisions, including the choice of C/C system and the validation strategy.

blocks.zh: TR73 與其他 PDA 技術報告的關聯：Section 3.2.5 提及其他 PDA TR 提供滅菌、CCI、玻璃缺陷相關資訊。主要關聯：
blocks.en: Relationship of TR73 to other PDA technical reports: Section 3.2.5 mentions other PDA TRs that provide information on sterilization, CCI and glass defects. The main links are:

blocks.zh: 滅菌：PDA TR1（輻射滅菌）、TR22（過濾滅菌）、TR26（蒸汽滅菌）
blocks.en: Sterilization: PDA TR1 (radiation sterilization), TR22 (sterilizing filtration), TR26 (steam sterilization)

blocks.zh: CCI：PDA TR27（微生物 CCI 測試）、TR51（確定性 CCI 測試）
blocks.en: CCI: PDA TR27 (microbial CCI testing), TR51 (deterministic CCI testing)

blocks.zh: 玻璃缺陷：PDA TR43（玻璃容器製造）
blocks.en: Glass defects: PDA TR43 (glass container manufacturing)

blocks.zh: 在台灣 CDMO 的實務中，建議建立這些 TR 的內部學習資源庫（如本知識平台），讓工程師在遇到特定問題時能快速找到對應參考文獻。
blocks.en: In the practice of a Taiwanese CDMO, it is advisable to build an internal learning library of these TRs (such as this knowledge platform) so that engineers can quickly find the relevant reference when a specific issue arises.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 的標準文件矩陣建議：在接受每個新 PFS 委託時，建議建立一個「適用標準矩陣」，對應 FDA 四要素：
blocks.en: Recommended standard document matrix for a CDMO: When accepting each new PFS contract, it is advisable to build an "applicable standards matrix" mapped to the four FDA elements:

blocks.zh: Protection：CCI 測試方法選擇 → PDA TR51/TR27
blocks.en: Protection: choice of CCI test method → PDA TR51/TR27

blocks.zh: Safety：E&L 研究計畫 → ICH Q3C/Q3D + USP <661>
blocks.en: Safety: E&L study plan → ICH Q3C/Q3D + USP <661>

blocks.zh: Compatibility：藥品-包材相容性研究 → USP <1664> + PDA TR26
blocks.en: Compatibility: drug-packaging compatibility study → USP <1664> + PDA TR26

blocks.zh: Performance：功能性測試 → ISO 11040 系列
blocks.en: Performance: functional testing → ISO 11040 series

blocks.zh: 這個矩陣可作為技術審查會議的基礎文件，確保在開發早期就識別所有必要的測試項目。
blocks.en: This matrix can serve as a base document for technical review meetings, ensuring that all necessary tests are identified early in development.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「compatibility（相容性）」和「safety（安全性）」在概念上不同，但在實務研究中又高度相關？各自需要哪些測試支撐？
blocks.en: Why are "compatibility" and "safety" conceptually different yet closely related in practical studies? What tests support each?

blocks.zh: 一個蛋白質生物製品 PFS 的 Target Product Profile 中，關於 C/C system 的主要需求可能包括哪些？
blocks.en: For a protein biologic PFS, what might the main C/C system requirements in the Target Product Profile include?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 法規定位：PFS 在美國為組合產品，由 PMOA 決定主管機關（CDER/CBER/CDRH）；21 CFR 4 提供「一主一輔」的雙重 GMP 合規路徑
blocks.en: Regulatory positioning: In the US, a PFS is a combination product, and the PMOA determines the lead authority (CDER/CBER/CDRH); 21 CFR 4 provides a dual GMP compliance pathway of "one primary, one supplementary"

blocks.zh: 三大系統功能：治療病患（劑量、給藥途徑）、取得市場許可（完整資料包）、生產與配送（製程相容性與冷鏈）— 三者相互牽動，必須整體規劃
blocks.en: Three key system functions: treating the patient (dose, route of administration), obtaining approval (complete data package), and production and delivery (process compatibility and cold chain) - the three affect one another and must be planned as a whole

blocks.zh: DMF 架構：Type III DMF 涵蓋彈性體元件的材料資訊；Type V DMF 涵蓋後處理製程驗證；授權信函機制確保供應鏈資訊流通
blocks.en: DMF framework: A Type III DMF covers material information for elastomeric components; a Type V DMF covers validation of post-processing; the letter of authorization mechanism keeps information flowing through the supply chain

blocks.zh: 申請內容要素：SAL 10⁻⁶ 滅菌驗證、CCI 評估、E&L 研究（特別注意鎢、矽油、黏合劑）、break-loose/glide force 測試是 PFS 申請的核心數據
blocks.en: Filing content elements: SAL 10⁻⁶ sterilization validation, CCI assessment, E&L studies (with particular attention to tungsten, silicone oil and adhesives) and break-loose/glide force testing are the core data for a PFS filing

blocks.zh: C/C 適用性四要素：Protection、Safety、Compatibility、Performance — 此框架應貫穿 PFS 開發的整個生命週期，從 TPP 定義到放行測試均需對應
blocks.en: Four elements of C/C suitability: Protection, Safety, Compatibility, Performance - this framework should run through the entire PFS development lifecycle, with each element addressed from TPP definition through release testing
